spec.assertion: No damage-moving buff is sourced from ether's slot, and emptying skill1 leaves every unit's total byte-identical. Fails under the nearest-wrong 'fold ally DR into damageTakenPct on the boss' (positive damageTakenPct = boss takes more), which would inflate the whole team; also fails if a value near 52.5 surfaces as a boss-held debuff (casterIdx null).

Two-point magnitude probe (atkPct EPS vs 1.0) recovers the implied percentage absolutely: 56.32 ±1%. Fails under the nearest-wrong ×3 credit for the '3 enemy unit(s)' header against the single-target boss (implies ~168.96), and under any dropped/duplicated instance. Guarded by a rotation-invariance assertion so the linearity premise is itself tested.

Instance count over 180s is >=2 and <=60 — interval-SHAPED. Fails under a one-shot/burstCast reading (count 1) and under a shotFired/hitCount reading (ether's 9-round SG fires far more than 60 times in 180s). The PERIOD itself is ⚑ (absent from kit text) and is deliberately NOT asserted.

Every rider damage event has rangeApplied === false (fails without noRange); flipping core:true on the same effect must ADD damage (fails if the shipped rider already cores, which the kit never licenses — no 'core strike' wording); rider events exist in BOTH FB states and only the in-FB ones carry fbMajorApplied (fails under noFb:true, which is measured-only and default OFF).

it.skip — no enemy-DEF-reduction primitive exists (defPct is SELF DEF and inert; damageTakenPct is a different mechanic at a different magnitude). Live companion assertion: no buffApply with stat damageTakenPct (or sourced from ether) carries a value near 9.38, refuting the DEF▼-as-damage-taken fudge. Trigger identity recorded as fullBurstEnter (team FB), NOT burstCast.

spec.kitLine: Shield = 96% of user final Max HP/5s
spec.assertion: No maxHpFlat / casterMaxHpPct / targetMaxHpPct / maxHpPct buff is sourced from ether — fails under the nearest-wrong 'shield as Max HP grant', which would feed an atkOfMaxHpPct consumer and manufacture ATK from a defensive line. Emptying the burst block moves no total in this comp (scope-limited inertness, explicitly stated as fixture-scoped, not a general claim).

it.skip — shield application emits no event on the onEvent bus and v1 has no HP pool (lowest-remaining-HP resolves to a documented leftmost-N stand-in), so the target set is behaviourally indiscriminable in any single-comp fixture.

At least one burstCast is attributable to ether. This is the gate on every other burst assertion: ether is Burst I and controlComp seats liter (also B1) competing for stage 1, so a zero here means the fixture — not the model — cannot exercise the burst slot.

ether produces normal-bucket damage events and a non-zero total — proves the weapon path is live, so the skill-bucket filters above are separating the rider from her normals rather than reading an empty unit.

fixtures: controlComp('ether', true) for all five runs — liter (B1) / crown (B2) / carry slot / helm (B3), deterministic, no seed. The fixed-B3 slot is kept ON: ether is a Defender with no ATK-scaled ally interactions, so helm's buffs cannot confound any assertion here (every magnitude claim is a within-run counterfactual delta, and every buff claim filters by ether's own slot). Five hoisted 180s sims: (1) baseline; (2) rider atkPct := 0.001 — a tiny non-zero probe rather than 0, so the damage instance and its per-impact burst-gauge contribution survive and the rotation stays byte-identical; (3) rider atkPct := 1.0 — the second magnitude probe; (4) rider core := true — the core-eligibility counterfactual; (5) skill1 + burst block arrays emptied — the defensive-line inertness run. ether's slot index is resolved at runtime from a buffApply she RECEIVES (liter/crown buff the squad), since her own kit emits no buffs; that resolution is itself asserted non-negative so a lookup failure is loud rather than silent. Override patching goes through a shape-agnostic blocksOf() helper that mutates the resolved Block[] in place, because the packet documents two competing slot shapes ({slot: Block[]} vs {slot: {blocks: Block[]}}); a patch-count guard asserts the counterfactuals were not silent no-ops.
gaps: skill2b DEF ▼ 9.38% for 6 sec on the boss (fullBurstEnter) — it.skip: no enemy-DEF-reduction StatKey exists. defPct is SELF DEF and inert in v1; damageTakenPct is a distinct mechanic with a distinct magnitude, so encoding it there would be a fudge, not an approximation. Needs an enemyDefPct stat plus a boss-DEF term consumer in the damage formula.

burst shield → teammate `shielded` trigger / requiresShielded gate — it.skip: no shield event kind is exposed on the onEvent bus and the controlComp roster seats no shield-consuming unit, so the tandem payload (the whole reason the line must not be dropped) is unobservable in this fixture. Needs a comp containing a shield-gated ally.

burst target set = 3 allies with the lowest remaining HP — it.skip: shield application emits no observable event, and v1 has no HP pool at all (lowest-remaining-HP resolves to a documented leftmost-N stand-in), so alliesLowestHp{count:3} cannot be discriminated from any other 3-ally target set behaviourally.

skill2a interval PERIOD — ⚑ not a test gap but an input-domain gap: the kit text gives the damage line no activation clause and no cadence, so the exact instance count is outside what a blind read can pin. The test asserts only the cadence SHAPE (repeating, far slower than per-shot); the period itself needs the datamined skill cooldown or a popup-counted recording.

skill1 ally Damage Taken ▼ — inert by scope, not by model: the assertions prove it moves nothing at scope lock (partless immortal boss, no HP pool, no DR-keyed trigger in the vocabulary). They do NOT prove the line would be inert if survivability were ever modeled.
